meta.name: acroform-fill
meta.description: Inspect, schema, and fill true AcroForm PDFs using sciClaw's pdf_form_inspect, pdf_form_schema, and pdf_form_fill tools. Use when: (1) checking whether a PDF is a real fillable AcroForm, (2) listing form field names, types, and choices, (3) filling a supported form from structured values, (4) preparing reviewable insurance, legal, administrative, or clinical form drafts, (5) reporting skipped fields or unused input keys after a fill. Do not use for scanned PDFs, OCR tasks, or XFA-only forms.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并填写可填写的PDF表单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量填写或审核可填写的PDF表单
copy.tagline_en: Inspect and fill fillable PDF forms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch fill or review fillable PDF forms

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能检查 PDF 是否为真正的可填写 AcroForm，列出表单字段名、类型和选项，并根据结构化数据或叙述文本填充表单，最后报告跳过的字段和未使用的输入键。
howto.when: 当用户询问 PDF 是否可填写、要求查看表单字段、或提供数据要求填充表单时触发。

say.text: 检查这个 PDF 是不是可填写的 AcroForm。
列出这个表单的所有字段和选项。
用这些数据填充表单：患者姓名是张三，出生日期是1990-01-01。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can inspect whether a PDF is a true fillable AcroForm, list form field names/types/choices, fill the form from structured data or narrative text, and report skipped fields and unused input keys.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks if a PDF is fillable, requests form fields, or provides data to fill a form.

say_en.text: Check if this PDF is a fillable AcroForm.
say_en.note: Claude runs pdf_form_inspect and reports the result.

say_en.text: List all fields and choices on this form.
say_en.note: Claude runs pdf_form_schema and shows the field inventory.

say_en.text: Fill the form with this data: patient name is John Doe, DOB is 1990-01-01.
say_en.note: Claude creates a JSON file and runs pdf_form_fill.
